_about: Adapter rows for web/src/world/adapters/stats.ts (Phase 5 adapter 4). Nothing here is science: every number a factor takes is an engine output (@rex/realism, by library id). `capabilities` lists, for each row of files/pirate-ship/body/data/body.json `capabilities`, the factors of its formula in the table's own words (stats.test.ts checks them against the formula text). A factor with no `outputs` has no engine output yet: it counts as 1 and the result names it as missing (web/src/world/FIXTURES.md, F-ST-*). `pathway` is the impairment a factor carries; BODY.md section 3: one pathway per impairment, so no pathway may appear twice in one formula. `pushes` are the rows of files/pirate-ship/body/data/psychology.json `pushes` the engine's outputs can drive (`row` is the 1-based row, `state` the start of its State cell); `inexpressible` are the rest, with what each needs. `faceSources[].channels` name the body.json `visible_faces` channels a face source reaches (the channel is a judgment, listed in FIXTURES.md F-ST-4).

forceAvailable(limb).why: no per-limb muscle force or fatigue output; the engine's muscular module holds indices, not a limb's force today

woundDip(limb).why: the engine counts open wounds by kind but gives no limb and no depth; the dip is a range by depth (x0.8 to x0.5)

legsFactor.why: the worse leg's woundDip: needs a wound's limb

balanceFactor.why: forceAvailable of glute_med and deep_core: no per-group force output

capFactor(limb).why: permanent caps (a stroke, a lost limb) have no engine output

coldFactor.why: the engine's core-temperature table gives a state, not a capability factor

hydrationFactor(Strength).why: the hydration table gives an Endurance multiplier only

painFactor(limb).why: the engine gives pain (medicine.pain) and its gating, but no factor from pain to coordination

drinkFactor(+).why: Nerve: rum raises the read (fiction, open in body.json); the coordination output falls with drink, so it cannot stand in

feverFactor.why: the engine's disease stages carry no fever flag or factor

bloodFactor.why: the bleeding class table names x0.8 for class II only; classes III and IV give no multiplier

nutritionFactor.why: deficiency stages are outputs (deficiency_<id>) but no table turns a stage into a Constitution factor

fatigueDay.why: fatigueDay needs the day's MET-hours against aerobic_today; the engine's fatigue_met_hours is a different accumulator

seaLegs.why: no engine output; a ship's motion is not modelled

light.why: light comes from the map (COMBAT 6), not the engine

nightBlindness.why: deficiency_vit_a is a stage; no table gives its Eyesight factor

alertness.source: neurology.circuits.arousal: the alertness factor is min(PHYSIOLOGY alertness, arousal) on the head attributes and Reflexes; alertness holds the circadian factor already

drinkFactor.source: neurology.circuits.motor-control: Dexterity and Agility x coordination; arousal enters once, in alertness

heatFactor.source: physiology.core_temp: work capacity at the core temperature

aerobicIndex.source: body.json: aerobic_today / 40 (PHYSIOLOGY 6); the engine gives oxygen delivery, so the index is per kg of the body (F-ST-1)

unapplied.painFactor: body.json marks it open (MEDICINE open 3): whether pain feeds Poise is undecided, so no factor is applied

notComputed.why: MUSCULAR 8 movement row: the weaker leg limits, needs per-leg force and a load; no engine output
a minimum over a duty's activation groups of force available / force required; no per-group force output
mood x madness x drink: mood and madness are the crew engine's meters, not the body engine's
needs the place's hazard base (ENVIRONMENT), the sea state and fatigueDay; none is an engine output yet
the art keeper's portrait (open): build, scars, pallor, jaundice are not outputs by id

faceSources.why: the bleeding class rows II to IV are the haemorrhage failure; class I has no sign

facesNotExpressible.why: no output says which delivery failure is active; haemoglobin is an output but the table gives no threshold for the face
saturation is an output; the table gives no saturation threshold for the face (medicine.exposure covers hypoxia)
heart failure is an event with no output by id
the eight events (angina, infarction, stroke, ...) have no engine output by id

inexpressible.needs: whether the character's madness trigger is being pushed (the story keeper's); not an engine output
hunger (the drive from hours and deficit): neurology reads it as an input; no engine output carries it. Meals missed are the host's
hunger over 0.8 for 3+ days: as row 5
starvation stage 2+ for 14+ days and the memories of who hoarded or shared: no starvation stage output, and the memories are the story keeper's
a meal's appetite, per meal: a meal event is the food adapter's, appetite is a circuit output but the row asks for a meal eaten
appetite low while hunger is high, per refused meal: hunger and a refused meal are host facts
favourite and hated foods per character: open, the story keeper's
starvation stage: the engine's starvation_limit is a flag (0 or 1), not a stage; the row asks for stage 2+
a ration of rum drunk that evening: an event the host raises
'drunk' has no engine threshold on conc_alcohol; the row gives about +20 for the night, not a limit
the row gives no size for the slider pressure
fever: the engine's disease stages carry no fever flag; the row also pushes alertness, which is the engine's already
seasickness: no engine output; a ship's motion is not modelled
a crew mate's death: an event, with hearts from the relationship web
a resurrection: open, the story keeper's
no one talked to for 3+ days: the dialogue system's
a post matching the character's best duty: the crew engine's
a post where they fail: the crew engine's
fear events (outnumbered, a storm): events, and the contagion between crew mates; fear-and-stress is an output but the row asks for the event
a win, a prize, fresh food: events the host raises
a romance partner wounded or sick: the relationship web

inexpressible.part: Volatile pressure; the craving push toward the habit; a slight if denied
inexpressible.needs: the row gives no size for these (the last is open)
